messages:
sara: Quick heads-up — we just published an open-source release: redwood-serving-sdk v0.9.0 to GitHub. :tada:

sara: Highlights: smaller runtime dependency surface, improved KV cache APIs, and a new batching config that reduces tail latency for short requests. Full changelog + migration notes linked below.

release-bot: Published release: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-serving-sdk/releases/tag/v0.9.0 — artifacts generated, changelog attached.

mike: Nice! Does v0.9.0 include the backpressure fix we added last week?

sara: Yes — the backpressure fix + a small tweak to how we expose per-request priorities. See the migration snippet in the changelog.

ci-bot: CI status: all checks passed on main for tag v0.9.0 — build 6124 ✅

carla: I'll draft the community tweet and a short thread for the forum. Can someone drop a 2–3 line blurb about the performance wins (p95 improvements) I can reuse?

mike: Measured ~18% p95 improvement on our internal eval suite with the new batching defaults (short-context chat workloads). You can say: "~18% p95 latency reduction for short-chat workloads with new batching defaults."

jordana: Also noting: the maintainer call is next Wednesday — thinking of a 30min retro + roadmap for v1.0. Would love one slide about customer migrations.

sara: Sounds good. Carla — I'll add a 1-paragraph summary and the perf number. Jordana — I'll prepare the migration slide with the two recommended commands and the config diff.

carla: Perfect. I'll schedule the thread announcing the release to community channels after your blurb, @sara.

mike: Quick example for docs (feel free to copy):
```
from redwood_sdk import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.generate("Summarize: How Redwood batching works", batching_config={"min_batch_size":8, "latency_slo_ms":150})
print(resp.text)
```

sara: Added that snippet to the release notes. Also called out known issue: older quantized checkpoints may need a model-conversion step (instructions included).

release-bot: Assets: source tarball, wheel, docker images pushed to ghcr.io/redwood-inference/redwood-serving-sdk:0.9.0

jordana: Nice work everyone. Can we make sure the security slack channel gets the CVE note? I filed a brief security note in the release; want to make sure security has it tracked.

sara: Done — pinged @security and filed tracking ticket INF-4822.

carla: I'll post to the community forum and schedule the Twitter thread for 2pm PT. tagging maintainers: @sara @mike @jordana

mike: :thumbsup:

sara: Thanks team — great cross-functional push. If anyone wants to join the maintainer call, I'll add calendar invite.

carla: RSVP'ed. :tada:
